name: 下班前上线

roles.name: 凌澈
roles.voice: young male, clean mid voice, flat and even, deadpan, cold, short phrasing

roles.name: 砚舟
roles.voice: young male, clear warm mid-low voice, chest-supported, slow and relaxed pace

look: 半写实插画风格，细腻笔触与柔和光影，安静的都市深夜与清晨质感。
setting: 一间书房：靠窗摆着一张书桌和一把转椅，桌上一盏台灯亮着，窗外是远处的城市。角色2始终坐在书桌前的转椅里没有离开，角色1离开后又回来。
constraints: 全片两个生成片段：第一段是下班前的深夜，第二段是第二天清晨，老板在第二段推门回来时用一句话点明已经隔了一天，两段之间是硬切。机位固定，角色2全程没有离开，一直坐在书桌前的转椅里；角色1第一段说完就走了，第二段又推门回来。角色1语气急躁、催得紧，角色2语气慢而稳。全程中文对话。画面中只有这两名角色，环境中任何可见文字都是中文。
source_script:
角色1：小程，下班前新版本一定要上线！
角色2：好的，没问题！
角色1离场：关门出去。
角色2动作：他还在工位上敲着键盘，听见门响抬起头。
角色1入场：开门进来
角色1：新版本昨天怎么还没上线？
角色2：我还没下班呢

execution.look: A semi-realistic illustration style with fine brushwork and soft light, in the quiet mood of an urban night and early morning.
execution.setting: A study room: a desk and a swivel chair stand by the window, a desk lamp glows on the desk, and the city is visible far outside the window. Character 2 stays seated in the swivel chair at the desk the whole time, while Character 1 leaves and then comes back the next morning. Every legible text in the environment is in Chinese.
execution.visible_state: A study room lit by a glowing desk lamp on the desk, with soft light coming through the window. Character 2 sits in the swivel chair at the desk facing left, a cup of tea in his hand, looking up calmly toward the door.

voices.character_1: young male, clean mid voice, flat and even, deadpan, cold, short phrasing
voices.character_2: young male, clear warm mid-low voice, chest-supported, slow and relaxed pace

directions.event_003: Character 1 pushes the door shut and walks out of frame, and the room is left lit only by the desk lamp while Character 2 stays seated at the desk.
directions.event_004: Character 2 keeps typing at his desk in the lamplight, then pauses and lifts his head toward the door as the handle turns.
directions.event_005: Character 1 opens the door and steps into the room, and bright early-morning daylight floods the space through the window behind Character 2.
